title: Long term names wrap in the dropdown and on the customer card
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the shop's own term A has a 31-character name and is the default; its own term B also has a 31-character name, is deactivated and is held by customer A.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's customer page.
  2. Open Edit Customer.
  3. Open the Credit Terms dropdown.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The card shows the whole of "term B (Inactive)", wrapping if needed.
  • Nothing is cut off.

Step 2:

  • The selected value shows the whole name and "(Inactive)".

Step 3:

  • Term A shows in full followed by its "Default" tag, and "term B (Inactive)" shows in full.
  • Long names wrap.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11674 (Story 5, New Customer and Edit Customer)

  • S5-R14: “Term names are never cut off in the Credit Terms dropdown or on the customer card, including with "(Inactive)" or the "Default" tag; long names wrap.”
